name: CLMT
recent: CLMT 在 2026 年 10 月 21 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，净利与可分配收入均上升，并宣布每单位派息 1.35 仙。同期，雇员公积金局 (EPF) 与退休基金局 (KWAP) 多次申报股权变动。新闻亦提及公司正推进工业与物流资产扩张。
notable: 2026 年 10 月 21 日公布季度业绩，净利 4702 万林吉特，并宣布每单位派息 1.35 仙。
2026 年 10 月 22 日新闻指出第三季每单位派息按年上升 21.6% 至 1.35 仙。
2026 年 10 月 23 日新闻提及公司依赖工业资产扩张动能。
risks: KWAP 与 EPF 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年第三季营收 1.2654 亿林吉特，按年增 9.3%，按季增 2.8%；净利 4702 万林吉特，按年增 34.1%，按季增 6.9%；净利率 37.2%，高于上季的 35.8%。

recent_en: CLMT released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 21 October 2026, with higher net profit and distributable income, and declared a distribution per unit of 1.35 sen. During the same period, EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests. News also mentioned the company's ongoing expansion into industrial and logistics assets.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results on 21 October 2026 with net profit of RM47.02 million and declared a distribution per unit of 1.35 sen.
News on 22 October 2026 reported that third-quarter distribution per unit rose 21.6% year-on-year to 1.35 sen.
News on 23 October 2026 mentioned the company is banking on industrial asset expansion momentum.
risks_en: KWAP and EPF filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between September and November 2026.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 revenue was RM126.54 million, up 9.3% year-on-year and 2.8% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM47.02 million, up 34.1% year-on-year and 6.9% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 37.2%, higher than 35.8% in the previous quarter.
